Dynamic recrystallization (DRX) is a common phenomenon during hot deformation of alloys, especially at high temperature.

the increase of Mo element content can contribute to the strength improvement but is harmful to ductility. According to Saad Sheikh's theory, adding elements with low VEC to RHEAs can improve the plasticity of the alloy. The VEC of Mo is 6, while the VEC of equimolar ratio VNbMo alloy is 5. Therefore, an increase of Mo content will lead to an increase of the VEC of the alloy, thereby reducing plasticity.
